Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 657 PM EST Wed Nov 25 2026
 

- Widespread rain develops Thanksgiving afternoon and continues into
  Friday. Wet snowflakes may mix in at times.

- Another round of rain is likely to end the weekend.

&&

.AVIATION...

Broken coverage of mixed MVFR/VFR ceiling is moving west of the 
terminal corridor this evening with the exception of additional 
patches from Lake Erie into the DTW area. Nocturnal strengthening of 
the low level inversion helps duct additional Lake Erie cloud 
moisture into renewed MVFR coverage that moves over the DTW corridor 
late tonight and Thursday morning. A brief break above 5000 ft then 
precedes the large mid Appalachians low pressure system that spreads 
rain into SE Mi by late Thursday afternoon. A few wet snowflakes are 
in reach as the profile wet bulbs and saturates, however increasing 
rain intensity ends up the primary visibility restriction. NE wind 
also becomes a highlight with this system as gusts reach 30 knots 
mid afternoon into Thursday evening.  

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* Medium for ceiling at or below 5000 feet after 08z Thursday, then 
  high after 18z.
